_comment: Chanter hand-authored sim mechanics, same schema as aion2c/data/src/mechanics.json. Every Num carries confidence + source. Values at RANK 1 unless stated. Global client dump 2026-09-18; KR patch differences listed in NOTES.md. 2026-10-03 mechanics pass: hand-maintained from here on (build_mech.py is superseded): stat-mod statuses, Dark Crush window triggers, Wind's Promise crit proc, specialization_effects.

triggers.note: applies on a landed attack with a 10 s internal cooldown and a 5 s duration: chance 0.1 per cast = one application per ~10 casts (~1 s each) = ~50% uptime

onslaught.note: chain 1/3 (client), restores 100 MP; 2 hits; spec rank 12 -1s Spinning Strike cooldown on hit; spec rank 16 adds Storm Chain. chain window unknown; 3.0 s placeholder (same as Sorcerer default), calibrate in app

resonance-crush.note: chain 2/3 (client), restores 100 MP, 5 hits. chain window unknown; 3.0 s placeholder (same as Sorcerer default), calibrate in app

storm-chain.note: added by Onslaught spec rank 16 (Metaroad: 'Adds Storm Chain Chain Skill'); restores 180 MP; position in the chain unknown

incandescent-blow.note: chain 1/2 (client), MP cost 120, 2 hits, 2 stagger. chain window unknown; 3.0 s placeholder (same as Sorcerer default), calibrate in app

impactful-crush.note: Stun 3 s: 60% on players, 100% on NPC targets (client text) -> 1.0; boss Incapacitated Immunity is not modelled. Opens Dark Crush for 2 s through a cast trigger (see triggers).

crushing-blow.note: Multi-Hit on Stunned targets; chain child of Impactful Crush in KR before Aug 26 patch (replaced by +30% Skill Speed spec); global client lists no parent

wave-blow.note: needs a Stunned target (description). 7% chance to change motion vs Incapacitated-Immune targets: boss CC immunity makes the Stun gate uncertain. Knockdown 3s. Spec rank 12 applies wave_blow_debuff (not auto-applied here)

wave-blow-18080037.note: hidden passive-type variant (Required level 4, Max 1) with identical text to Wave Blow; probably the motion-change variant. Not rotation relevant

dmg_mult.source: base hit
Metaroad has Level 1/2/Max rows without ratios
spec rank 8 'Changes to Charge Skill, dealing up to 200% more damage' = up to 3.0x

rushing-smash.note: Charge Skill only with the rank 8 specialty; without it a plain 15 s rush. Restores 100 MP. Community: remove from macro, press by hand (aoeah 2026-09-10)

dark-crush.note: usable only while dark_crush_window is open (2 s after Impactful Crush / Spinning Strike, 3 s after Ensnaring Mark / Marchutan's Wrath; tokens se:1810000711 / se:1810000811). Opened by cast triggers so one AND-only `requires` is enough. 5 s cooldown, removed by spec rank 16. Piercing Strike chain (spec rank 12) is a trigger proc.

piercing-strike.note: added by Dark Crush spec rank 12; shares the Dark Crush window logic (KR patch note groups them)

recuperation.note: heal + HoT, removes 1 debuff, party within 40m, cooldown 15s (aion2.app client dump 2026-09-18); defensive/heal, not in damage rotation

fracturing-blow.note: rush 20m, -30% Defense 5s; +20% damage vs Impact-type targets

focused-defense.note: guaranteed Block, restores 110 MP and Stamina once on Block (rank 1), sustained skill

heat-wave-blow.note: 40% Seal 3s on Block, 100% on NPC; spec rank 8: 40% Stun; reset chance on Block with spec rank 16

sprint-mantra.note: toggle: +10.5% Move Speed, 15% on-hit heal (1s cooldown) for caster and party

undefeated-mantra.note: toggle party aura; does not stack with Cleric Light of Protection (higher rank wins, ties go to Undefeated Mantra)

defiance.note: removes Stun/Knockdown/Airborne/Grab/Frost/Fear; unaffected by cooldown reduction; spec rank 8 adds Crushing Strike chain

crushing-strike.note: added by Defiance spec rank 8; Stun 3s; 120 s cooldown (Metaroad)

tremor-crush.note: 50% Stun 3s after Dodge or while flying, 100% on NPC; spec rank 12 adds Surging Strike

surging-strike.note: added by Tremor Crush spec rank 12; 30% Airborne 3s on Stunned targets

ensnaring-mark.note: Seal 5 s: 50% on players, 100% on NPC targets (client text). Opens Dark Crush for 3 s through a cast trigger.

spinning-strike.note: 20 m AoE, MP 250, cd 30 s in global dump. KR Aug 26 patch: cd 15 s, MP 100, +30% speed (aion2hub Aug 26 2026 patch notes (Korea)); global client not updated. Opens Dark Crush 2 s; crit damage +15% x2 stacks 30 s | Dark Crush window is opened by a cast trigger, not by `applies`.

gust-rampage.note: needs a Staggered target; spec rank 8 restores 120 MP and -1s all cooldowns at rank 16

marchutans-wrath.note: Dark Crush ready 3s; spec rank 10 50% Stun, rank 15 -70% Incoming Heal and Potion Recovery on target (PvP) | Opens Dark Crush for 3 s through a cast trigger.

guardian-blessing.note: +5.4% Max HP 300s, immediate 5.4% heal, not dispellable

barrier-spell.note: HP floor 10% for 3s; 180s cooldown not reduced by cooldown increase effects

assault-shock.note: 30% Stun 3s (100% on NPC); +defense up to 20% by targets hit; spec 5: +20% Attack 5s

protection-circle.note: passive: stacks on each landed attack (0.5 s ICD), 10 stacks pop Divine Barrier; Noble shield below 50% HP, 60 s cooldown

earths-promise.note: passive: debuff on each landed attack, 10 s cooldown; does not apply together with Cleric Chain of Torment

raging-spell.note: passive proc: 146 flat extra damage (rank 1) vs targets Staggered OR Impact-type, 1 s cooldown; AND-only requires lists staggered only | auto-gated by the 'afflicted with Stagger' text (needs_stagger): never fires until a stagger window exists; internal cooldown 1 s in skills.json

winds-promise.note: passive proc on crit: 50% chance, 554 flat at rank 1 (token se_dmg:1880000111), internal cooldown 1 s (token abe:1880000011 value03 = 1; applied as the skill cooldown in skills.json per_level)
